question.body:
The Maclaurin series for $ln lr((frac(1,1 - x)))$ is $sum_(n = 1)^(oo) frac(x^(n),n)$ with interval of convergence $- 1 <= x < 1$.

(a) Find the Maclaurin series for $ln lr((frac(1,1 + 3 x)))$ and determine the interval of convergence.

(b) Find the value of $sum_(n = 1)^(oo) frac((- 1)^(n),n)$.

(c) Give a value of $p$ such that $sum_(n = 1)^(oo) frac((- 1)^(n),n^(p))$ converges, but $sum_(n = 1)^(oo) frac(1,n^(2 p))$ diverges. Give reasons why your value of $p$ is correct.

(d) Give a value of $p$ such that $sum_(n = 1)^(oo) frac(1,n^(p))$ diverges, but $sum_(n = 1)^(oo) frac(1,n^(2 p))$ converges. Give reasons why your value of $p$ is correct.
